news.content: Life update: I received my Ph.D. degree from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and joined Huawei Hong Kong Research Center (HKRC) as a Senior Research Engineer!
news.content_zh: 人生新阶段：我已从香港理工大学博士毕业，并正式入职华为香港研究所（HKRC），担任高级研究工程师！

news.content: Our paper SiPeR on situated conversational recommendation has been published at ACL 2026 (Main Conference, Long Paper)!
news.content_zh: 我们关于情境会话推荐的论文 SiPeR 发表于 ACL 2026 主会（长文）！

news.content: Received the Excellent Intern Award during my internship at Huawei Hong Kong Research Center (HKRC), Fermat Lab.
news.content_zh: 在华为香港研究所（HKRC）费马实验室实习期间，获评优秀实习生。

news.content: Started a Research Internship at Huawei Hong Kong Research Center (HKRC), Fermat Lab (Huawei 2012 Labs), focusing on LLM-related mathematical reasoning data generation.
news.content_zh: 开始在华为香港研究所（HKRC）费马实验室（华为 2012 实验室）担任研究实习生，主要从事 LLM 数学推理相关数据构建工作。

news.content: I will attend ACM MM 2024 in Melbourne, Australia. Welcome to have a chat with me at the conference!
news.content_zh: 将参加在澳大利亚墨尔本举办的 ACM MM 2024，欢迎在会场交流。
